text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While we were out, Gentildonna mentioned wanting
to look at bags, so we stopped by a department store.
And then—

"Hey hey, big sis,
hold the bag and pose like this!
Pleeease!"

"Oh, Vivlos, really...
They're for sale, so you can't do that, o~kay?
Let's just burn their cuteness into our memories."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking over, Verxina and her younger sister Vivlos were there.
Unlike when facing Gentildonna,
Verxina wore the gentle expression of an older sister.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah—! It's Gentildonna-san~~~!
Trainer-san, hello to you too!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...! Ah, so you were out shopping
with your Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Yes. To check out the new line of bags.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The moment Verxina is confronted with Gentildonna, the look on her face changes.
Did we interrupt their private sisterly time?
choice_data_list: Gentil, I'll go on ahead to another shop—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
The new bag is the one we were looking at!?
You were interested in it too, Gentile-san?!
Waaaaah, I feel so close to you right now♡

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"H-Hold on, Vivlos?!
It's rude to get that close to—"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
My, you certainly have an eye for quality.
After all, you wouldn't want to miss out on a collaboration with a renowned British designer, would you?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! The gold belt buckle looks suuuper celebrity-chic, it totally makes my heart flutter!
I wanna take that and go to a party on a cruise ship~!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry, Gentildonna-san.
I must have startled you..."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"No, not at all. Please, enjoy yourself.
I'll be looking elsewhere."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Your concern is unnecessary.
...Vilros, let's go.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehhh~, already? I wanna keep watching~.
.........Can't I?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
................
Understood. Please make sure not to be rude.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For a while after that, Gentildonna and Verxina passionately discussed their love for bags.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! Gentildonna-san said
she's buying that bag!
I want one too~~~! Please, Big Sis!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? But it's a pretty mature design, isn't it?
Would it really match Vivlos's clothes?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
It's okay! Until I grow up,
I'll let you big sisters borrow it!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You might not use it, Cheva-chi,
but Big Sis loved it, right?
So I want you to use it! It really suited you!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Vivlos...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
And you know, when I grow up,
I'm gonna take that and go to a party! ♡
Wearing a suuuuuper fancy celeb dress!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, pleeease? Pretty please, with a cherry on top~~!
Big siiiister... ♡

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Geez, fine already. I'll buy it for you.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my.
You've always got a soft spot for your little sister, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...You're right.
In a strict household like yours, such an act would surely be out of the question.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
However, Vivlos is a hard worker who puts in honest effort, pursuing her dreams directly.
She even took 1st place in the mock race the other day.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Being strict is not the only form of love.
For me, this is how I show
my affection as an older sister.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For a moment I worried about how things would turn out,
but I was relieved we managed to finish shopping without any real trouble.
choice_data_list: So you really are totally different from your older sister?
Are you really totally different from your older sister?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I have no memory of ever being bought
something unconditionally like that.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
What one desires must be seized with one's own hands.
Ever since I was little, making deals with my parents and siblings
whenever I wanted something was only natural.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: If you beg for something, you create an opening in yourself. It could also lead to being drawn into an unfair deal.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I have never begged my older sister for anything,
nor has my younger brother ever begged me for anything.
We have been "equals" ever since we were born.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Equality"—even as a child, you're treated like an adult, with no holding back whatsoever. It's astonishingly strict, but that severity is just another form of love.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's the complete opposite of the Verxina sisters.
To think the ways love is shown could differ so drastically from family to family.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Or do you believe that a method like Verxina-san's
would better foster healthy growth?"
choice_data_list: I think there are times like that too.
No, it's better if you're strict.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I see...
Then as a test, perhaps I should bring you
something thoughtful to snack on?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Finding that a bit scary in its own way,
I hurriedly replied that "things are fine as they've always been."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: My, it seems we are of one mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna cast a meaningful glance at me before
walking toward the station. I lightly slapped my cheeks
with both hands for no particular reason and followed her.
